textos.<1>Más allá de # (opcional).</1> La proy: <1>Beyond # (optional).</1> The official projection ends in #. To look further ahead, two curves are offered that start from the last official figure. The <2>exponential</2> curve keeps the rate of the last five years: it is the appropriate one for the short term (up to ten years). The <3>logistic</3> curve assumes that growth slows as it approaches a ceiling, because land, water and jobs are limited: it is the appropriate one for the long term. The ceiling is estimated from the INE series itself; if the series does not slow down, there is no ceiling to estimate and the exponential curve is used. Tested five years ahead against INE's own figures, the two deviate very little; for the long term there is no data by municipality to test them against (see the statistical verification).

textos.Cada archivo recibido queda en este hist: Every file received stays in this history with its date. What counts in the statistics is not the date it was uploaded but the file's <1>cut-off</1>: the registration month that the data request declares (or, if it declares none, the month in which the event occurred). If a file arrives with a new cut-off, it is added to the history; if one arrives with a cut-off that was already there, it <2>replaces</2> the previous one for that cut-off (the previous one stays here as “replaced” and its pending items are no longer shown). The original file is not stored —it contains personal data—, so to analyze a submission again with new rules it has to be uploaded again.

textos.Cómo se agrega una tienda o un rubro: un: How a store or a category is added: one more task in <1/> with the store's base address, the category and the search terms. Six reading methods are supported: search by terms and full catalog by categories (stores built on VTEX technology), site map with structured data for each product, paginated listing (Magento stores) and the public catalog of Shopify and WooCommerce stores. Only open addresses are read, with a pause between queries; if a store responds that it does not allow the query, the task stops and does not try again. A full catalog takes several minutes and runs in the background. Construction prices enter the comparison against the IPMC automatically; food prices appear in "Basic food basket"; all of them can be consulted in "Prices by category". Suma, Super del Barrio and Mi Super Fresh do not publish a catalog with prices online (only informational pages), and PriceSmart requires a browser with a session: they are not sampled.

textos.Se toma el precio más reciente de cada p: For each store, the most recent price is taken of every product whose name contains all the search words. The mean, median and mode are calculated. A price is extreme if it lies more than {0} times the interquartile range outside the quartiles (Tukey's rule) or if it exceeds {1} times the median (or falls below the median divided by {2}). If there are extremes or the coefficient of variation exceeds {3} %, the median is recommended; if the prices are similar, the mean. With fewer than {4} prices, none is recommended. The interval for the median assumes no distribution of the prices (order statistics) and is only given with six or more prices. The calculation is deterministic: the same prices always give the same result.

textos.Todo corre en un servidor propio: Rust y: Everything runs on a self-hosted server: Rust and PostgreSQL, a single container, with no paid services or external models making decisions.
textos.Todo está agrupado en cinco bloques: pan: Everything is grouped into five blocks: overview, administrative records, territory, prices and data. Anything that requires an account only appears after signing in.

textos.Todo lo que FARO produce se puede bajar: Everything FARO produces can be downloaded as GeoJSON or CSV, with its source and license, ready for a GIS.
textos.Todo lo que muestra el portal lo calcula: Everything the portal shows is calculated by the portal itself with fixed, visible rules: it does not use external services to decide, and the same input data always gives the same result. There is a single piece that is not a rule written by the team: the fieldwork photo classifier, a scene model already trained by third parties (Places#, MIT) that runs inside the server itself. It only says whether a photo looks like a dwelling or a business, the photo is not stored and its result never decides: it flags the visit for a person to review. When new data arrive, the figures are recalculated on their own: submissions, pending items, equivalences, rates, progress and the records map come from the database on every query; prices are updated by the sampling runs; and the tables derived from open sources (population, road network, built-up area, boundaries) are each regenerated with one command, downloadable next to each result.

textos.Un modelo de escenas dice si parece vivi: A scene model says whether it looks like a dwelling, a business or something else. The photo is discarded: it is not stored.
textos.Un modelo de escenas ya entrenado (Place: An already-trained scene model (Places#) runs inside the server, with no cloud. If the photo looks like a business, the visit is flagged for someone to review; the photo is discarded at the end.
textos.Un precio por proveedor (la mediana de s: One price per supplier (the median of its comparable products), converted to the IPMC unit. The reference price follows the rule of the Dirección de Precios (mean if they are similar, median if there are extremes) and requires at least three suppliers. The last column is the index published by INE.
textos.Un precio por proveedor en la unidad ofi: One price per supplier in the official unit; mean if they are similar, median if there are extremes; warns if direct sources are missing.
textos.Un prototipo que solo corre en la máquin: A prototype that only runs on its author's machine cannot be evaluated or adopted; and a list of sources without dates cannot be verified.
textos.Un Sistema Estadístico Nacional en el qu: A National Statistical System in which each institution delivers its data only once, in a common format, and the country puts them to use the same day, confident that nothing was guessed and everything can be verified.
